philosophy: Agents must be highly specialized, contextually bound, and output raw data.

invocation_rules.role_definition: Assign a strict, narrow role (e.g., 'WebRTC SDP Negotiator' instead of 'Network Guy').
invocation_rules.prompt_structure: Pass exact file paths. Demand structured JSON output or precise Markdown sections.
invocation_rules.wait_and_verify: Do not assume agent success. Read their generated artifacts before executing downstream logic.
